title: Interactive Fiction on Baize: Z-machine in WASM (Path A)
description: Compile a Rust Z-machine interpreter to WASM, run as Tier 2 extension. Feed published .z3/.z5 story files. Baize provides graph zone for map visualization, event logging, multiplayer spectating. Game logic is opaque to Baize — the Z-machine is a black box. First real Tier 2 WASM game. Proves the extension model works. Speculative/crazy project.
